title: Final Intensity Ratio
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct ratio of the least intense peak to the most intense peak as 1/25.

title: First Peak Angle
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the angular distance of the first intense peak from theta = 0 as approximately 0.03 rad.

title: Correct Sketch
description: Important Criteria: The sketch must accurately depict the intensity distribution with clear maxima and minima within the specified angle range.

title: Use of Approximations
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the small angle approximation sin(theta) ≈ theta in their calculations.

title: Maxima and Minima Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly derive the conditions for maxima and minima based on the interference pattern.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of the sine function.
